notes.title: Meet the Rebels: Quincy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/2684ef11d87e44014b309b6b0cb387618392ffc5.png[/img]

In the serene embrace of the Evergreen Hills, Quincy the opossum found peace and contentment. These lush, rolling landscapes stood as a refuge on Animalek, untouched by the destructive reach of the Sapiens. Amidst this tranquility, Quincy built a life filled with quiet joy alongside her partner. Together, they decided to start a family, blessed with seven beautiful babies who thrived in their idyllic haven.

Yet, as tranquility so often does in a world under threat, it proved fleeting. The Sapiens, relentless in their pursuit of power and resources, set their sights on the Evergreen Hills. A scientific facility for meteorological experiments sprung up, transforming the vibrant hills into a frigid wasteland within months. The climate became harsh and unforgiving, a shadow of its former self.

Quincy’s partner, driven by love and determination, confronted the Sapiens to reclaim their home but vanished without a trace, leaving Quincy alone to face an escalating nightmare. The extreme cold claimed her babies one by one, tearing at her heart with every loss.

Desperation spurred Quincy to flee, clutching her last surviving offspring as she ventured into the freezing unknown. But as the snowstorm raged around them, hope dwindled. Exhausted and out of options, Quincy succumbed to the bitter cold, collapsing in the snow.

Awakening in a dark room, Quincy finds herself alone, her child nowhere in sight. Confusion and fear grip her as she realizes that her struggle, far from over, has only just begun. Driven by the profound loss of her family, Quincy embarks on a journey to find answers and reclaim her life amidst the encroaching darkness.

notes.title: Meet the Rebels: Bardo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/e23ed7f5955c44efc664d497550851b810f272ee.png[/img]

Bardo is a bear, working as a fisherman, who lived a quiet and secluded life in the caves of Evergreen Forest. He wasn't fond of socializing, and almost all his interactions with the forest animals were limited to selling his catch and buying supplies to take back to his cave. One day, the Sapiens appeared at his door, looking for local Animals to help with security at a new plant they were building in the heart of the forest. Of course, this did not interest him, and he immediately rejected the offer.
However, a few months after the plant was built, the climate of the forest changed radically, freezing rivers and lakes and destroying his only source of livelihood. One day, his door rang again. This time, it was a group of animals. They were organizing to protest against the Sapiens plant and the destruction of the ecosystem. Bardo decided not to help, requesting not to be involved in the matter.
But days went by, and hunger grew stronger. Hungry and alone, he decided to accept the security job offered by the Sapiens to obtain provisions for the season. They gave him a weapon and a uniform and stationed him at the entrance of the plant, with orders to dispatch any intruders.
Until one day, a group of animals—the same ones who once knocked on his door for help—arrived at the plant, intending to sabotage the facility, armed with sticks and rakes. Bardo heard the order over his intercom to open fire at the slightest provocation. Having never harmed anyone in his life and trying to avoid a massacre, Bardo attempted to talk to the animals. But before he could convince them to leave, he heard a gunshot from behind him, and one of the animals collapsed in front of him.
What followed was total chaos. From the watchtowers, security forces opened indiscriminate fire on the animals. Some were running for their lives, while others, furious, tried to attack the walls of the plant. Bardo froze in the midst of the chaos, and before he realized what was happening, the gunfire stopped, while the group of animals lay lifeless on the ground. Horrified, Bardo returned to his cave, reflecting on his actions.
The next day, he heard someone calling at his door again. It was Quincy, an opossum from the village, asking about her husband, who had not returned home. The image of an opossum who was with the protesting group came to his mind. The same one who had collapsed in front of him and now lay lifeless in the snow. Consumed by guilt, he returned to the plant, this time to recover the bodies of the deceased animals.
He heard over his communicator the order to leave the bodies where they were, as they would be collected for experimentation. Bardo did not want to listen; he just wanted to take the bodies back to their families. However, the order turned into threats. He had to desist from what he was doing at that very moment or there would be consequences. Bardo ignored the shouts in his communicator and turned it off. Carrying the bodies of the animals back to the village. However, as he turned, he heard another gunshot behind him. This time, he could feel the bullet in his back. That is the last thing he remembers before waking up confused in a dark prison. But this, was but the start of his adventure…

notes.title: Meet the Rebels: Wata
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/6ce77d7df8ba7afb4f91fb403c79e5a94faab96d.png[/img]

In the chaotic streets of SC01, survival is an art form, and Wata, a female cat, has mastered it. Born and raised among the shadows of the city’s underbelly, she made a living through pickpocketing, hacking, and executing minor scams. The thrill of outsmarting her targets was exhilarating, but it also attracted the attention of much more dangerous entities.

One day, her life took an unexpected turn when a group of Sapien scientists approached her, seeking voluntary subjects for their experiments. Initially, it seemed like easy money, a quick way to escape the grind of street life. Wata even recommended other animals for the program, oblivious to the escalating risks involved. But as the experiments became progressively extreme, the consequences became all too real. 

Wata lost most of the fur on her skull, but that was only the beginning. In a horrifying moment, her neck was replaced with a mechanical component—an alteration that not only changed her voice but also made eating painfully difficult. This shocking transformation pushed her to her limits, and Wata resolved that she would never again accept the Sapiens' insidious offers.

Just as she began to regain a sense of normalcy, she received an unwelcome call on her interlink: the scientists were summoning her once more. This time, they revealed that her mechanical neck was part of a broader project aimed at eliminating the need for regular animal sustenance, intending to replace it with "XSapien Brand nutritious gruel," a new product from XSapien Corp. The thought disgusted her; she had no intention of becoming part of their twisted agenda.

With determination, Wata firmly refused their proposal and demanded to never be contacted again. She believed she had finally escaped their grasp. But fate had other plans. One fateful night, while she slept in the safety of an alley, she was jolted awake by the sound of approaching footsteps. Before she could react, a shadowy figure placed a bag over her head, followed by a searing electric shock.

When she regained consciousness, Wata found herself in a dark cell—alone, disoriented, and in agonizing pain. As she huddled in the corner of her confinement, uncertainty swirled around her. With her freedom now a distant memory, Wata braced herself for whatever horrors lay ahead, determined to fight for her escape and reclaim her life.

notes.title: Devlog 6 - Workshop
notes.content:
Hi!

Here with our sixth Dev Diary.
Its time to start introducing what we call "The Stations". These are places in the map where the player can do all sorts of things (beyond fighting for freedom), like Upgrading Cards or buy cool stuff.

This time, we get to meet the mobile workshop and its lovely staff. In here players can upgrade card, destroy cards, or fix any broken cybernetic parts your Hero may have.
 The staff isnt super friendly, but will deliver every time.

notes.title: Devlog 1 - Animals and families
notes.content:
Hello,

We present you our first devlog entry, the idea is to upload a weekly one telling you about the development of the game.

Today: [b]The animals[/b]

There are several animal families that share the decks, but each animal has its own unique card. Here we present the [b]slashers [/b]and the [b]maulers[/b].

[h2]Slashers[/h2]

Slashers specialise in hiding, dodging and bleeding the enemy (sometimes even bleeding their allies!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/89dc4797d8a349b49a5e03d7481f045cc826572d.png[/img]

For now we have the cat, the panther and the lion, whose unique cards are 9 lifes, black panther and roar. You can imagine what each of these cards does ;)

[h2]Maulers[/h2]

They specialise in debuffing enemies to hit harder. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/d66d3b2b7f98eca8b1277db06b907f75d1980354.png[/img]

For now we have the dog, the possum and the bear, whose unique cards are guardian, 
play dead and onslaught.

We continue to work on more animals and families, stay tuned.
